card.description: The student DJ crew's Playlist Bot predicts which songs to play at the dance. Each record is one song. The label is Banger (a song people love to dance to) or Skip (a song to leave out).

context.potentialUses: Use the bot's predictions to help choose songs for the school dance.
context.potentialMisuses: It is trained on only 20 songs picked by one group of students, so it may predict poorly for other songs or schools.

fields.description: Did the song come out before 2025?
